name: Okuno Yoshiki
source:
The main character of this work.
He is a shy and withdrawn person. 
His mother, worried about him, half-heartedly urged him to participate in summer camp.

In contrast to his small stature, he has a large penis.
Of course, he is still a virgin and this is his first time experiencing sex at camp.
